title: Spec: Gherkin for procedure-vs-description mode detection
description: Spec-first. Scenarios: a numbered/stepped section is detected as a procedure and judged with procedure limits; running prose is detected as description and judged with description limits; mixed topics report the mode used per finding; unclassifiable text falls back to description limits.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Spec complete: 6 Gherkin scenarios for auto mode detection (numbered topics, imperative prose, prose descriptions, mixed documents, detectedMode summary, explicit-mode override); confirmed red (2 failed + 2 errored) before implementation.
